PRIORITIES: Play Tropical Island, then cast Birds of Paradise. Next turn play Swamp and cast Grist, the Hunger Tide (3 mana with Birds). Use Grist +1 to mill and make an insect. Then play Forest. After that, Gravebreaker Lamia: search for a Capsule or Seal into the graveyard to stock a lane. Then Muldrotha around the fourth land plus Birds.
THREAT: Edgar Markov (P3) goes wide with vampire tokens, and our wipes are the answer. Giada (P2) grows angels. Watch Sephiroth (P4) for its sacrifice/drain engine.
HOLD: Bojuka Bog: play it as a land drop only when an opponent's graveyard holds real value, or when it's the only land left. Siren Stormtamer: keep it for protecting Grist or Muldrotha from targeted removal. Don't run it out as a 1/1 unless the board is empty.
REPLAN IF: Birds dies (then Grist goes a turn later). P3 floods the board with tokens (then prioritize finding a wipe). Someone plays graveyard hate.

PRIORITIES: 1) Planetary Annihilation: keep Bayou, Tropical Island, Breeding Pool, Overgrown Tomb, Hinterland Harbor and one Swamp. Sacrifice the other Swamp. 2) Muldrotha is stuck in our graveyard with no recursion in hand, so play for draws. 3) Next turn, cast Gravebreaker Lamia first. Its search puts a card into the graveyard, so pick one we can use from there (a flashback, escape or unearth card, or a reanimation target). If none exists, pick our best reanimation target. 4) Then cast Gray Merchant if mana allows, or hold it (see HOLD).

THREAT: P1's The Scarab God, Teval and zombies from Field of the Dead. P1 is the table's biggest board and should draw everyone's removal.

HOLD: Gray Merchant until our devotion to black is 4+ or P2 is at 4 or less. It is our only reach.

REPLAN IF: We draw reanimation or a wipe. P1 attacks us with 3+ creatures. Our graveyard is exiled. Scarab God targets our graveyard.

PRIORITIES: 1) Cast Muldrotha from the command zone (8 of our 10 mana). 2) Use Muldrotha's land lane: play Misty Rainforest from the graveyard, crack it for an untapped Island or Forest dual. That leaves 3 mana. 3) Cast Grist from the graveyard (planeswalker lane) and +1 for an Insect token. Next turn, -2 sacrificing the Insect to destroy Gitrog. 4) Keep Tropical Island, Darkslick Shores and Mind Stone in hand for later turns.

THREAT: P4's Gitrog Monster. P3's Sauron (7/6) and the Dreadhorde Invasion army. P1's Pantlaza, backed by 5 cards.

HOLD: Shriekmaw for a nonblack Pantlaza or dinosaur. Syr Konrad and Braids until Muldrotha survives a turn cycle.

REPLAN IF: Muldrotha is countered or removed: instead play Tropical Island, cast Mind Stone and Grist. P1 casts Pantlaza. A wrath or graveyard hate appears. Grist is attacked down: use -2 at once.

PRIORITIES: 1) Play any land drawn first. 2) Cast Talisman of Dominance with Watery Grave and Overgrown Tomb. 3) Cast Seal of Primordium using Zagoth Triome for G. 4) Keep Talisman untapped for Swan Song. 5) Next turn with 4 or more mana, cast Grist first. Use -2 on Sephiroth or Stromkirk Captain, whichever is attacking us. Then cast Braids or Barrin. Then Muldrotha at 6 mana.

THREAT: P4's vampires with Shared Animosity and Edgar still to come. P3's Sephiroth with The Masamune. P2's Atraxa long-term.

HOLD: Hold 1 blue from Talisman for Swan Song, to counter a wipe, Edgar's removal or a key instant. Keep Cryogen Relic until a lethal attack or a draw is needed. Save Seal of Primordium for Masamune, a rock or Shared Animosity. Hold Ratchet Bomb until next turn, then set it at 0 to hit tokens. Glen Elendra waits for 4 or more spare mana.

REPLAN IF: Edgar resolves or P4 reaches 4 or more attackers: cast Grist and Braids for blockers first. Sephiroth equips Masamune and swings at us: Seal the Masamune. We draw Deluge or Deed: prioritize the wipe.

PRIORITIES: Play Verdant Catacombs now and crack it immediately. Fetch a Swamp-typed blue dual (Watery Grave) if one is in the library, otherwise Overgrown Tomb. We have only two lands, so thin the deck and fix colours. Turn 2: play Wooded Foothills and fetch the missing colour, ideally Breeding Pool, so we have U, B and G. Then cast Cryogen Relic to dig for lands. Turn 3: cast Plaguecrafter or Seal of Primordium, whichever the board needs. Aim for Glen Elendra, Braids and Barrin on turns 4–5.

THREAT: Edgar Markov (P4) goes wide with vampires fastest. Atraxa (P2) is the long-game threat.

HOLD: Seal of Primordium for a real target: Sol Ring or another mana rock, Edgar's anthem, or an Atraxa proliferate engine. Don't spend it on a random rock. Hold Plaguecrafter until a lone creature is worth hitting.

REPLAN IF: We miss land drops (prioritise Cryogen Relic and cheap cantrips). P4 floods tokens early. A turn-1–2 Sol Ring appears (Seal it).

PRIORITIES:

Next turn, play any land drawn immediately and cast Sol Ring off it. Then cast Wayfarer's Bauble and crack it for a Forest, or an Island if we already have a Forest. HOLD: Invasion of Innistrad as flash removal once we have 3 mana. Executioner's Capsule for a commander, not a utility creature.

REPLAN IF: We are still landless after next turn, which means we must dig with Bauble and Sol Ring. Anyone plays graveyard hate. A commander resolves before we have 3 mana.

PRIORITIES:
1) Cast Muldrotha from the command zone with all 6 mana. Breeding Pool supplies the blue.
2) Land lane: play Misty Rainforest from the graveyard. Crack it for an untapped dual or basic, which gives 1 extra mana.

- Muldrotha is countered or removed.
- Doc Aurlock dies (graveyard casts go back to full cost).
- Commander tax makes Muldrotha cost more than 6. If so, cast The One Ring instead.
- A board wipe resolves.

PRIORITIES: 1) Play Takenuma, Abandoned Mire, then cast Sol Ring. That gives about 6 mana this turn. 2) We have no blue source, so Muldrotha can't be cast yet. Spend the mana on Syr Konrad, the Grim (5). If Konrad isn't castable, cast Baba Lysaga plus Dalek Drone as the mana allows. 3) Future land drops and fetches should prioritize finding blue for Muldrotha next turn.

THREAT: P4's Deathrite Shaman (ramp, graveyard exile). P1's Pantlaza will go wide once it has lands. Sauron is unknown.

HOLD: Seal of Primordium for an opposing rock or engine. Kaya's Ghostform until Konrad or Muldrotha needs protecting. Soul-Guide Lantern until an opponent's graveyard matters, such as a Sauron or Deathrite value pile.

PRIORITIES: 1v1 vs P2 (40 life). Binding the Old Gods finished and is now in our graveyard, so recast it. 1) Cast Binding the Old Gods from graveyard (enchantment lane, 6 mana). Chapter I destroys The Gitrog Monster. 2) Cast The Death of Gwen Stacy from hand. If it removes something, take the Bird Token 4/4, else Szarel. 3) Cast Kokusho from hand. 4) Evoke Mulldrifter from graveyard (creature lane) to draw 2. 5) Put the remaining mana into Walking Ballista from graveyard (artifact lane). Ping Sabotender. 6) Attack with Muldrotha only if Gitrog is gone and the Bird is tapped or dead.

HOLD: Siren Stormtamer to protect Muldrotha. Ballista counters for instant-speed removal. Seal of Primordium waits for next turn's enchantment lane to hit Zuran Orb.

REPLAN IF: P2 counters or answers Binding (then keep Muldrotha home), or P2 casts a wipe.

1) Cast Muldrotha before your land drop. Try to keep {2} open afterward for Barrin; if the taxed cost is too high for that, still cast her.

PRIORITIES:
1. Play Bloodstained Mire from the graveyard as the land drop (land lane) and crack it for Underground Sea or Watery Grave. Keep Forest in hand.
2. Cast Arcane Signet.

HOLD: Ratchet Bomb, as the answer to the next token swarm. Professor Dellian Fel, for next turn's mana. Claws of Gix, for a sacrifice in response to removal.

1. T1: play Bloodstained Mire and crack it now for a U/B dual (Watery Grave-type) or a basic Swamp. Cast Claws of Gix (free). If the dual is untapped, cast Siren Stormtamer as an early blocker against Edgar.

PRIORITIES: 1) Play any land drawn. 2) Cast Massacre Wurm (6). It kills P3's Faerie token, Vampire token, Nether Traitor, Merciless Executioner, Mavren Fein and Pawn of Ulamog, so P3 loses 12. None of P4's creatures die. 3) Cast Sakura-Tribe Elder (2) and keep it untapped as a blocker. Keep Boseiju in hand for its channel removal. 2) Cast Eternal Witness and return Nature's Lore. 3) Cast Nature's Lore and fetch a Forest-type land untapped, a Triome if one is in the library. 4) If a black source is still untapped, cast Executioner's Capsule. 5) Next turn: land drop, cast Muldrotha, then Secrets of the Dead. TARGET: Next turn: Swamp, then Grist (1BG from Tropical, Swamp and Birds), then Grist +1 for an Insect token. Our turn after: Forest, and hold U for Stormtamer. Turn 4: Lamia (5 mana); tutor Executioner's Capsule or Seal of Doom to the graveyard. Turn 5: Muldrotha (6 mana), recasting Grist, Capsule and Seal every turn. Missing pieces: Sol Ring or Arcane Signet (ramp), Gray Merchant or Syr Konrad (closers).

Don't chump-block, and avoid needless creature deaths while Sephiroth or Blood Artist is out; each death drains us.

HOLD: Bojuka Bog until P4's graveyard has real targets. If no target by our turn 4, play it as a tapped land on a turn with spare mana. Once Muldrotha is out, keep U open for Stormtamer to protect her.

REPLAN IF: Birds dies (skip Grist, play lands, delay). A Plunderer or Altar loop piece lands early (prioritise Grist −2 on it). We draw Sol Ring or Signet (Muldrotha a turn sooner).

2) P3's Archangel of Tithes: Fel's -3.
3) P2's Hearthhull if cast: Assassin's Trophy.
Keep Lamia home as a blocker.

HOLD: Gray Merchant until Lamia is on the battlefield (devotion 3), or until P2 is at 6 or less.

REPLAN IF: Any opponent exiles Muldrotha (put it in the command zone and recast it). We draw Bojuka Bog (target P1's graveyard). P1 gains more than 3 Zombies. P2 casts Hearthhull.

THIS TURN: 1) Tap all 8 (Sol Ring plus six lands) and cast Muldrotha, using B, G and U from Overgrown Tomb, Forest and Breeding Pool. 2) If Muldrotha resolves, play Misty Rainforest from the graveyard as the land drop. - Baleful Strix, artifact lane, 2
- Grist, planeswalker lane, 3: −2, sacrificing Strix, to destroy Gitrog
- Gwen Stacy, enchantment lane, 3: destroy Teval
